## Purpose

Support tree-height, slope and distance-estimation workflows using device measurements and supplied distances.

## Capability IDs

- `spatial_geometry`

## Requirements

- Relevant onboard sensors.
- A measured horizontal distance where required.

## Supported XLSForm calls


**From `example_odk_spatialgeometry.xlsx`:**

```text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='tree_height_measurement',input_horizontal_distance_m=${input_horizontal_distance_m},input_observer_height_m=${input_observer_height_m},input_base_angle_deg=${input_base_angle_deg},input_top_angle_deg=${input_top_angle_deg},return_mode='flat')
```
